objective: Turn M132's 512-bit dual-row PWP service-port hypothesis into a standalone elastic RTL assembler with cycle-exact 2/2/2/3 service for signed 8/9/10/11-bit 96-lane vectors.

motivation.m132_cycle_model: Exact held-out schedule replay predicts 1.431769986x module cycles versus compact PWP256 and 4.541455956x versus the frozen fixed8 service-island denominator, but it leaves the 16-word bank mapper, macro, conflicts, frequency and energy unmodeled.
motivation.repair_scope: M133 admits only the executable 512-bit service-port assembler and protocol. It does not make 512-bit SRAM bandwidth free.

expected_pass_line: PASS M133 dualrow512 elastic PWP stream VCS vectors=105 outputs=105 beats=236 lanes=9696 escapes=4 ii_checks=63 stalls=43 long_stall=23 boundaries=5 protocol_attacks=2 reset_attacks=1 idle_payload=1 cycles_8_9_10_11=2_2_2_3 input_bits=512 bank_mapper=false macro=false physical_speedup=false system_speedup=false headline=false
paper_safe_statement: Commercial VCS verifies a standalone 512-bit service-port assembler that reconstructs signed 96-lane vectors in 2/2/2/3 accepted beats for 8/9/10/11-bit PWP payloads, including exact numeric scoreboarding, elastic stalls and fail-closed attacks. The upstream 16-word bank mapper, SRAM macros, conflicts, physical cost and system speedup remain unadmitted.
prohibited_claims: Do not call the 512-bit input a free SRAM or bank interface.
Do not claim two physical SRAM rows can be read per cycle from this module.
Do not promote the M132 1.431769986x or 4.541455956x cycle ratios to physical or system speedup.
Do not claim macro area, power, energy, FPS, accuracy, system speedup, DATE headline or best-paper readiness.
